Minimalist program.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Minimalist program.question: It models a speaker's knowledge of language as a computational system with one basic operation, namely _____
Minimalist program.fact: It models a speaker's knowledge of language as a computational system with one basic operation, namely Merge. Merge combines expressions taken from the lexicon in a successive fashion to generate representations that characterize I-Language, understood to be the internalized intensional knowledge state as represented in individual speakers.

Minimalist program.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Minimalist program.question: Such questions are informed by a set of background assumptions, some of which date back to the earliest stages of generative grammar: _____ is a form of cognition
Minimalist program.fact: Minimalism is reductive in that it aims to identify which aspects of human language—as well the computational system that underlies it—are conceptually necessary. This is sometimes framed as questions relating to perfect design (Is the design of human language perfect?) and optimal computation (Is the computational system for human language optimal?) According to Chomsky, a human natural language is not optimal when judged based on how it functions, since it often contains ambiguities, garden...

Minimalist program.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Minimalist program.question: In particular, variation reduces to _____ arbitrariness, parameters and the mapping to PF
Minimalist program.fact: In particular, variation reduces to Saussurean arbitrariness, parameters and the mapping to PF.

Minimalist program.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Minimalist program.question: The theory of grammar meets the criterion of conceptual necessity; this is the Strong Minimalist Thesis introduced by Chomsky in (_____)
Minimalist program.fact: The theory of grammar meets the criterion of conceptual necessity; this is the Strong Minimalist Thesis introduced by Chomsky in (2001).

Minimalist program.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Minimalist program.question: (See discussion of feature-checking below.) _____ of representation requires that grammatical structures exist for a purpose
Minimalist program.fact: Minimalism further develops the notion of economy, which came to the fore in the early 1990s, though still peripheral to transformational grammar. Economy of derivation requires that movements (i.e., transformations) occur only if necessary, and specifically to satisfy feature-checking, whereby an interpretable feature is matched with a corresponding uninterpretable feature.

Minimalist program.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Minimalist program.question: This is what is meant by "Language is an optimal solution to legibility conditions" (Chomsky _____:96)
Minimalist program.fact: This is what is meant by "Language is an optimal solution to legibility conditions" (Chomsky 2001:96).

Minimalist program.question: Interface requirements force deletion of features that are uninterpretable at a particular interface, a necessary consequence of _____
Minimalist program.fact: Interface requirements force deletion of features that are uninterpretable at a particular interface, a necessary consequence of Full Interpretation.
